opening.argument: The presentation demonstrates the construction and operation of an ordinary Victoria's Secret gift card holder. It identifies the product as a "Victoria's Secret Gift Card Holder" and explains that "When you slide out the panel, an additional panel slides out automatically to reveal the gift card." The visible holder and gift card support that product-design explanation. Nothing described involves an investment offer, a payment requirement, a request for credentials, a deceptive promise, or a transaction outcome.

citations.quote: When you slide out the panel, an additional panel slides out automatically to reveal the gift card.
